_comment: Rooman Billing product modules - the canonical list an organization can be entitled to. Identical copy: frontend/src/entitlements/modules.json (asserted by tests). base modules are part of every subscription; core_nav_items and unmapped API routes are always available. api_prefixes are /api/v1-relative path prefixes (longest match wins).

modules.label: Customers
modules.description: Customer records, contacts and billing details.

modules.label: Products & Plans
modules.description: Product catalog, plans, price books and the pricing engine.

modules.label: Invoices & Credit Notes
modules.description: Invoicing, GST-ready documents and credit notes.

modules.label: Subscriptions & Usage
modules.description: Recurring billing, trials, metered usage and proration.

modules.label: Reconciliation
modules.description: Match payments against bank and gateway records.

modules.label: Dunning
modules.description: Automated payment recovery and retry policies.

modules.label: Customer Portal & Hosted Payments
modules.description: Self-service customer portal and hosted payment pages.

modules.label: Customer Lifecycle
modules.description: Onboarding, health and renewal tracking per customer.

modules.label: Automation
modules.description: Workflow rules, schedules and automation logs.

modules.label: Integrations
modules.description: Payment gateway, email and accounting integrations.

modules.label: Mobile & Desktop Apps
modules.description: Register and manage the mobile and desktop apps.
